data.name: 迷途猫StrayCat
data.detailed_description:
GamePlay

Play as the Messenger Cat — move, crouch, jump and dash to reach the finish line.Use special combo key moves to beat levels faster!Or stay observant and hunt for weird hidden little nooks?

During the journey, you may also encounter many companions. Your interactions with them might influence the subsequent course!

The game’s main storyline takes approximately 3 to 5 hours to complete. Aside from the main campaign, we also offer a wealth of additional game content!

Players can choose their playstyle freely. The main story chapters are fairly straightforward, ideal for players who have never tried similar games. At the same time, we have prepared matching challenges for players who enjoy speedrunning, collectible hunting, or puzzle-solving!

Game Plot

In this game, players step into the paws of a messenger cat. You travel across a shattered land to deliver letters that stand for hope to its inhabitants, and uncover long-forgotten secrets buried deep underground along your journey.

The game boasts several maps with unique themes, such as wild mountains, castles, mine tunnels and towering spires. Every themed area features exclusive environmental settings and level mechanics.

The game is still in early development. All art visuals, level designs and narrative presentation may be revised and optimized in the future.

Development Team

Cold Tone Development Team is a three-person crew made up of two fanatical creators, three stubborn visionaries, ten brainstorming minds, two pet cats, two game designers, two programmers, two artists, one hundred and fifty-five scattered ideas, and a fire extinguisher. The team devotes itself to developing various compact, highly playable games of diverse genres, aiming to bring players unforgettable gaming experiences.

StrayCat marks the team’s debut commercial project. We still have a long journey ahead to finish the full game. If there’s any content you’d love to see implemented, or if you want to keep up with all game development news, come join our community to share your thoughts!!! Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!

Communication Hub

Catch the latest, exclusive development updates!

-QQ Group

data.short_description: Stray Cat is a platform jumping game featuring exquisitely polished control feel, stylized pixel art and a lighthearted, cheerful narrative. The game is relatively accessible in terms of difficulty, yet it also offers a more challenging gameplay mode.
